title: Rectangular block (3 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. For the first part, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch consists of a closed loop made up of four lines: the first line starts at (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.03, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.03, 0.0) and ends at (0.03, 0.03); the third line starts at (0.03, 0.03) and ends at (0.0, 0.03); and the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.03) and ends at (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scale factor of 0.03 to this sketch. Transform the sketch into three dimensions using Euler angles and a translation vector, both set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The dimensions of this rectangular block are 0.03 units in length, 0.03 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

For the second part, create another coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of (0.015, 0.015, 0.0). Draw a new two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch includes a larger rectangle defined by four lines: the first line starts at (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.1905, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.1905, 0.0) and ends at (0.1905, 0.0952); the third line starts at (0.1905, 0.0952) and ends at (0.0, 0.0952); and the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.0952) and ends at (0.0, 0.0). Within this rectangle, draw a circle centered at (0.0952, 0.0476) with a radius of 0.0095. Apply a scale factor of 0.1905 to the sketch. Transform the sketch into three dimensions using Euler angles and a translation vector, both set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0002 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The dimensions of this rectangular plate with a central circular hole are 0.1905 units in length, 0.09525 units in width, and 0.0001905 units in height.

For the third part, use the same coordinate system settings as the second part. Draw a new two-dimensional sketch on a new face, identical to the sketch in the second part. Apply the same scale factor of 0.1905. Transform the sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0019 units along the normal direction and add the extruded part to the existing body from the second part. The dimensions of this extended rectangular plate with a central circular hole are 0.1905 units in length, 0.09525 units in width, and 0.001905 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Vertical rectangular section
part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.03, 0).lineTo(0.03, 0.03).lineTo(0, 0.03).close().extrude(0.75)

# Part 2: Rectangular base with a hole
part_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.015, 0.015).lineTo(0.1905 + 0.015, 0.015).lineTo(0.1905 + 0.015, 0.0952 + 0.015).lineTo(0.015, 0.0952 + 0.015).close().circle(0.0095).extrude(0.0002)

# Part 3: Additional rectangular section with a hole
part_3 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.015, 0.015).lineTo(0.1905 + 0.015, 0.015).lineTo(0.1905 + 0.015, 0.0952 + 0.015).lineTo(0.015, 0.0952 + 0.015).close().circle(0.0095).extrude(0.0019)

# Combine parts
r = part_1.union(part_2).union(part_3)

import cadquery as cq

# Create the base rectangular plate
base_plate = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.2055, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.2055, 0.0975)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0975)
    .close()
    .moveTo(0.1027, 0.0522)
    .circle(0.0097)
    .extrude(0.0019)
    .translate((0.0, 0.0127, 0.0))
)

# Create the vertical rod
vertical_rod = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0285, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0285, 0.0285)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0285)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.75)
    .translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
)

# Combine the parts
r = base_plate.union(vertical_rod)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Vertical post: square cross-section, full height
post = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.03, 0.03, 0.75, centered=False)

# Base plate lying on the ground, extending in +X and +Y from the post
plate = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0.015, 0.013, 0.0))
    .box(0.1905, 0.0972, 0.01, centered=(False, False, False))
)

# Hole through the base plate (centered on plate)
hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0.1102, 0.0617, -0.01))
    .circle(0.0115)
    .extrude(0.03)
)

# Combine post and plate, then cut the hole
r = post.union(plate).cut(hole)

import cadquery as cq

post_x = 0.0302
post_y = 0.0302
post_z = 0.7500

base_x0 = post_x
base_len = 0.2055 - post_x
base_w = 0.1102
base_t = 0.0200

post = cq.Workplane("XY").add(
    cq.Solid.makeBox(post_x, post_y, post_z, cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
)

base = cq.Workplane("XY").add(
    cq.Solid.makeBox(base_len, base_w, base_t, cq.Vector(base_x0, 0, 0))
)

hole = cq.Workplane("XY").add(
    cq.Solid.makeCylinder(0.0075, 0.0600, cq.Vector(0.1500, 0.0551, -0.0100))
)

r = post.union(base).cut(hole)
